summary: eslint-plugin-folder-schema preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall="node setup.mjs". setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases (v1.3.13) into a temp directory, marks it executable, and then invokes it against the sibling file math_init.js with cwd of the package directory. math_init.js is a ~727KB Bun-compiled bundle (header `// @bun @bun-cjs`) with heavy identifier mangling, a string-array rotator, and a per-charcode decoder — opaque code with no relation to any ESLint functionality. The package advertises itself as an ESLint plugin (`eslint-plugin-folder-schema` by ServiceTitan) with a placeholder README (`TODO: description`, `TODO: Usage`) and a small legitimate-looking rule stub at lib/index.js; none of the real install-time behavior corresponds to that advertised purpose. The alternate-runtime dropper (fetching a second runtime to execute an obfuscated bundle) bypasses Node-oriented tooling and delivers arbitrary attacker code on `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
